version.titre: The 10 most beautiful monuments in Paris
version.description: The 10 most beautiful monuments in Paris that you must not miss
phrases: 1/ The Eiffel Tower, built in 1889, is the most famous monument in Paris.
2/ The Louvre, the largest art museum in France, is located in Paris.
3/ Notre-Dame de Paris, a Gothic church, is a symbol of the city.
4/ The Sacré-Cœur, a religious monument, offers a breathtaking view of the city.
5/ The Seine, the river that runs through the city, is a place for relaxation and strolling.
6/ The Luxembourg Gardens, a green and peaceful space, are a refuge for Parisians.
7/ The Palais Garnier, a historic opera house, is a symbol of Parisian culture.
8/ The Pont Alexandre III, an iconic bridge, offers a spectacular view of the Seine.
9/ The Musée d'Orsay, a museum of modern art, is a place of culture and art.
10/ The Palais de la Découverte, a science museum, is a place of discovery and learning.
